# TESOBE Senti

> TESOBE Senti is a semi-proactive AI agent that runs beside development, staging and production systems. It combines their logs, metrics and telemetry (its own collectors, or Prometheus and Loki) with the source code behind them, finds the bugs, slowdowns and security holes that matter most, and proposes code fixes that a developer reviews and commits. It runs on the customer's own infrastructure, as its own operating system user with read-only access, and uses Claude Code with a spending cap per run. It is made by TESOBE GmbH in Berlin, and comes configured for the Open Bank Project (OBP-API and its apps). Source: https://github.com/TESOBE/Senti (AGPL-3.0).

## Senti

- [TESOBE Senti: watches your APIs and apps, and suggests security and performance fixes](https://senti.tesobe.com/): TESOBE Senti is an AI agent that runs beside development, staging and production systems. It combines their logs, metrics and telemetry with the source code behind them, finds the bugs, slowdowns and security holes that matter most, and proposes code fixes for a developer to review.
